description: Reverse engineering: mechanics diagram of single-story single-bay frame
message: Build a calculation model from the attached drawing and engineering specification, then run static analysis. Ask for clarification instead of guessing any image information that cannot be identified reliably.
engineeringSpecification: Material steel: E=205000 MPa, nu=0.3, density=7850 kg/m3. Column members use section HW300x300 (H=300 mm, B=300 mm, tw=10 mm, tf=15 mm; A=0.012 m2, Iy=0.0002 m4, Iz=0.0002 m4, J=0.00001 m4, G=79000 MPa). Beam members use section HN400x200 (H=400 mm, B=200 mm, tw=8 mm, tf=13 mm; A=0.008 m2, Iy=0.0002 m4, Iz=0.00003 m4, J=0.000005 m4, G=79000 MPa). Use SI units and the global-z-up coordinate convention. Use only the load cases and load magnitudes annotated in the drawing; do not add member self-weight. Analyze load combination ULS = 1 x D.
